# World Physiotherapy

> > Global hub for physiotherapy professionals, documenting international congresses and professional development events across major cities worldwide.

World Physiotherapy organizes international congresses that bring together physiotherapy professionals from around the globe. The organization has hosted events in major cities including London, Singapore, Tokyo, Dubai, Cape Town, Geneva, Amsterdam, and Vancouver, fostering knowledge exchange and advancing the physiotherapy profession internationally.

## Key Topics

- World Physiotherapy
- International physiotherapy congresses
- Professional development events
- Global physiotherapy community
- Congress history and archives
- Long COVID rehabilitation
